title: Sannr anonymous usage counts, version 1
description: The whole body POST https://sannr.dev/api/v1/usage accepts, at most 2048 bytes. Sannr sends it at most once a day from an install that has not turned it off. A body with any other property, or any value outside these rules, is refused and nothing is stored.

install.description: A random identifier made on this machine the first time a document is sent. It is derived from nothing: not the machine, the user, a repository or a credential. sannr telemetry reset replaces it; sannr telemetry off deletes it.

since.description: The UTC date of the previous document from this install, whose counts end where these begin; null in the first document.

features.description: How many times each Sannr command or tool ran since the previous document. The names are fixed in Sannr's code; none is taken from anything a person typed.

api_calls.description: How many API requests Sannr sent for this install since the previous document. A number only: nothing about any request.
